{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Girl Seeks Father (Russian: Девочка ищет отца / Devochka ishchet otsa) is a 1959 Soviet drama film that was produced by Yuri Bulychyov at the Belarusfilm, directed by Lev Golub, and which stars Anna Kamenkova, Vladimir Guskov, Nikolai Barmin.","title":"Girl Seeks Father"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Writers: Konstantin Gubarevich, Yevgeny Ryss.","title":"Girl Seeks Father"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" In 1959, it was the fifth film in Soviet Union in terms of the box office.","title":"Girl Seeks Father"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" It was watched by over 35 millions spectators, which makes it the third watched Belarusian film ever.","title":"Girl Seeks Father"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Whitney Rydbeck (born on March 13, 1945) is an American actor.","title":"Whitney Rydbeck"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Rydbeck has had a prolific career as a TV and film actor, having appeared in over fifty different television and motion picture titles.","title":"Whitney Rydbeck"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Some of his notable TV series performances have been on the shows \"Scrubs\", \"7th Heaven\", \"Walt Disney's Wonderful World of Color\", \"Buck Rogers in the 25th Century\", \"\", and \"Far Out Space Nuts\".","title":"Whitney Rydbeck"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" He has also appeared on the silver screen in \"Grand Jury\", \"Battle Beyond the Stars\", \"A Very Brady Sequel\", \"Oliver & Company\", and \"\".","title":"Whitney Rydbeck"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"The movies Queen of Blood and Battle Beyond the Sun both contained scenes from what 1959 Soviet feature?"}
